title: Realistic threat perception drives intergroup conflict: A causal, dynamic analysis using generative-agent simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning generative agents to minimal groups (Group A and Group B), manipulating their perception of realistic and symbolic threats, and measuring resulting outgroup-directed hostile actions, hateful language, and self-reported ingroup bias attitudes over time.

Simulating a hiring scenario where candidate agents are described with varying levels of physical attractiveness to measure its effect on employer agents' hiring decisions, interview invitations, and social impressions.

Simulating a hiring scenario where candidate agents are described as having native or foreign accents to measure its effect on employer agents' hiring decisions and progression through the recruitment stages.
